refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to remove a child from a parent node

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoNodePruneChild function retrieves the child of object at child_index, removing the child from object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: If object is a branch node, and child_index is in range, SilikoNodePruneChild returns a pointer to the child. Otherwise, SilikoNodePruneChild returns NULL. This pointer is no longer managed by object and must be passed to SilikoNodeDestroy or added as a child to another branch node to avoid a memory leak.
